name: Litigation Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I Litigation Committee
  will conduct a Special Meeting, at the following time and place,
  and will address the agenda listed below:

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th
  Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, April 17, 2023
  4:00 PM

  AGENDA

1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item not listed on the agenda

2) State of the Insurance Market and 2023-2024 Insurance Strategies

3) Workers’ Compensation Legal Panel Contracts Evaluations and Extensions  The Law
  —

  Offices of Allweiss, McMurtry & Mitchell; Armstrong & Sigel; and Goldman, Magdalin & Krikes

4) Intellectual Property Legal Panel Contracts: Request for Rate Increase  —  Bryan Cave Leighton
  Paisner and Polsinelli

5) Contract with Burke, Williams & Sorensen LLP/Michael Nebenzahl  —  Request For Extension
  and Rate Increase

City Clerk

Posted: April 13, 2023

 Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable
 efforts to accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call
  (310) 285-1014 (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least twenty-four (24) hours
  advance notice will help to ensure availability of services. City Hall, including the Conference
  Room 4A, is wheelchair accessible.
